title: qwen-chat component diagram
description: The qwen-chat crate: one binary built from src/ with llama.cpp compiled in, which reaches the network only to download the model weights from Hugging Face.

components.name: qwen-chat sources
components.responsibility: Command line, chat loop, prompt format, inference and the weights download.

components.name: llama.cpp (llama-cpp-2 crate)
components.responsibility: Loads the GGUF weights and runs the model, on Metal on macOS and on the CPU elsewhere; built from source and linked statically.

components.name: Hugging Face
components.responsibility: Serves the pinned Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M GGUF file.

relationships.description: Model loading, tokenizing, decoding and sampling (engine.rs).
HTTPS download with resume on first run (download.rs).
